name: PayPal AI Hackathon 2026
theme: Build a working app, agent or automation that meaningfully uses both PayPal (APIs, SDKs, developer tools) and AI. No fixed tracks.

eligibility.notes: Spain is eligible. Multiple entries allowed if substantially different. Existing projects must be significantly updated after 2026-10-01 09:15 PT.

requiredTech: At least one PayPal API, SDK or developer tool, used meaningfully
platformTools: PayPal REST APIs: Orders v2 (capture/authorize), Payments, Vault, Subscriptions, Invoicing, Payouts, Disputes, Transaction Search, Webhooks
PayPal JS SDK v6, Pay Later
PayPal Agent Toolkit and MCP server (local, or remote at mcp.paypal.com / mcp.sandbox.paypal.com)
Agentic commerce: Agent Ready, Store Sync

video.rules: show the project working on its target device; no unlicensed music or trademarks

submission.repo: public GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket with all code, assets and setup instructions
submission.license: open source license file, detectable and shown in the repo About section
submission.demo: hosted URL or complete run instructions
submission.testAccess: sandbox logins / test keys in README, free and live until 2026-12-15
other: AI tools statement: every model/tool/service and how it was used

stages: Stage 1 pass/fail: fits the theme and reasonably uses PayPal

criteria.name: Technological Implementation
criteria.description: Depth and quality of the PayPal and AI integration. First tie-breaker.

criteria.name: Design
criteria.description: Complete, coherent product experience, not a proof of concept.

criteria.name: Potential Impact
criteria.description: Credible case that it solves a real problem for a real audience.

criteria.name: Presentation
criteria.description: Video and pitch clearly show the project working end to end.

judging.tiebreak: criteria in the order above, then judges' vote

prizes.name: Best Use of AG Grid
prizes.requires: uses AG Grid; polish (custom widgets, theming) and Studio Agent Framework reportedly valued

prizes.name: Best Use of Bryntum
prizes.requires: uses Bryntum Gantt, Scheduler or Calendar

prizes.name: Best Use of Channel3
prizes.requires: must call the Channel3 API or MCP server; promo code PAYPAL-HACKATHON-2026 gives 20k credits

stacking: At most one Grand Prize or one category prize, plus at most one sponsor prize.

sponsors.name: AG Grid
sponsors.tool: AG Grid, AG Charts, AG Studio

sponsors.name: APIMatic
sponsors.tool: Context Plugin (gives agents PayPal API context)

sponsors.name: Channel3
sponsors.tool: Product data API / MCP over 100M+ products

sponsors.name: Postman / Elastic / Astropods / Zapier
sponsors.tool: API tooling, search, agent hosting, automation
